scenes.title: Room Four Rings Twice
scenes.summary: Room 4's desk buzzer gives its signature double ring, and Youngmi brings the old green cloth botanical book downstairs to inspect with Mina and Junho.

scenes.title: Between the Mint Leaves
scenes.summary: In Room 9, Youngmi lifts the missing bottom half of the berry-and-almond cake recipe from between pressed mint leaves, though an old raindrop blurred the final line.

scenes.title: Three Small Baking Tins
scenes.summary: In the café kitchen, Sora puts aprons on Minsu and Mina to bake three small test cakes with three different glazes.

scenes.title: Batch One Is Too Sour
scenes.summary: After Sungmin measures the lemon glaze for Batch One without his reading glasses, Junho takes one bite and declares it sour enough to polish brass.

scenes.title: Batch Two Crunches Loudly
scenes.summary: Minsu unveils Batch Two with a heavy toasted sugar top so hard that his brother Jihoon jokes he could use it to tile a courtyard roof.

scenes.title: Smelling the Pressed Page
scenes.summary: Holding the smudged recipe card up to the Room 9 window light with Youngmi, Sora spots a tiny orange-blossom sketch and smells wildflower honey and sweet orange peel.

scenes.title: Ten Out of Ten in Pencil
scenes.summary: Sora serves Tin Three brushed with warm honey and orange zest; Junho eats in silence, writes ten out of ten in his paper ledger, and asks for a second slice.

scenes.title: The Red Star Upstairs
scenes.summary: Sharing cake in the courtyard, Jihoon compares the four-card puzzle map to the second-floor wooden balcony and spots an old brass lantern ring right where the red star points.
